newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - MICRON TECHNOLOGY CUT.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - MICRON TECHNOLOGY CUT.

text.p: Brown Brothers Harriman said on Wednesday it lowered its short-term rating on the shares of Micron Technology Inc to avoid from sell, while keeping its long-term market perform rating on the stock.
-- Analyst William Milton Jr said he cut his fourth quarter earnings estimate to $0.42 per share from $0.51 per share, bringing his 1997 earnings estimate to $1.11 per share.
-- Milton said he cut his 1998 estimate to $2.10 per share from $2.25 per share.
-- Milton cited growing concerns about declining memory chip prices and excessive DRAM (dynamic random access memory) overcapacity.
